items.summary_html:
🚀 Release autogpt-platform-beta-v0.6.38

Date: 26 November 2025

🔥 What's New? New Features
  • #11415 - Add Get Linear Issues Block (by @Swiftyos)
  • #11370 - Add inline node title editing with double-click (by @Abhi1992002)
  • #11421 - Implement agent outputs viewer and improve UI/UX in new builder (by @Abhi1992002)
  • #11407 - Parameterize activity status generation with customizable prompts (by @majdyz)
  • #11412 - PR preview banner (by @0ubbe)
  • #11406 - Add GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.1-codex models (by @Bentlybro)
  • #11446 - Add claude opus 4.5 model (by @Bentlybro)
  • #11422 - Add latest grok models (by @Bentlybro)
  • #11425 - Add google banana pro model (by @Bentlybro)
  • #11413 - Add gemini-3-pro-preview model (by @Bentlybro)
Enhancements
  • #11368 - Improve customNode reusability and add multi-block support (by @Abhi1992002)
  • #11397 - Improve new builder performance and UX with position handling and store optimizations (by @Abhi1992002)
  • #11420 - Improve error handling of SendEmailBlock (by @Swiftyos)
UI/UX Improvements
  • #11431 - Environment aware favicon (by @0ubbe)
  • #11432 - Fix tab titles (by @0ubbe)
  • #11433 - Make agent output clickable (by @0ubbe)
  • #11447 - Show spinner during login/logout (by @0ubbe)
Bug Fixes
  • #11374 - Remove un-runnable agents from schedule (by @Swiftyos)
  • #11400 - Fix logout console issues (by @0ubbe)
  • #11401 - Fix save-and-run with no agent inputs (by @Pwuts)
  • #11396 - Resolve marketplace agent access in get_graph_execution endpoint (by @majdyz)
  • #11394 - Resolve production failures with comprehensive token handling and conversation safety fixes (by @majdyz)
  • #11395 - Add custom validator to handle short-text and long-text formats in form renderer (by @Abhi1992002)
  • #11404 - Capture Sentry Block Errors Correctly (by @Swiftyos)
  • #11430 - Fix login/signup pages away redirects (by @0ubbe)
  • #11459 - Fix code scanning vulnerability (by @0ubbe)
Dependencies & Maintenance
  • #11411 - Bump the development-dependencies group across 1 directory with 3 updates (by @dependabot[bot])
  • #11435 - Bump faker from 37.8.0 to 38.2.0 in /autogpt_platform/backend (by @dependabot[bot])
  • #11353 - Bump cross-env from 7.0.3 to 10.1.0 in /autogpt_platform/frontend (by @dependabot[bot])
  • #11449 - Update Node.js versions in GitHub workflows to match frontend requirement (by @Pwuts)
  • #11451 - Security upgrade @sentry/nextjs from 10.22.0 to 10.27.0 (by @ntindle)
🎉 Thanks to Our Contributors!

A huge shoutout to everyone who contributed to this release:

  • @Swiftyos
  • @Abhi1992002
  • @0ubbe
  • @Pwuts
  • @majdyz
  • @Bentlybro
  • @ntindle
  • @dependabot[bot]
📥 How to Get This Update

To update to this version, run:

git pull origin autogpt-platform-beta-v0.6.38

Or download it directly from the
Releases page.

For a complete list of changes, see the Full Changelog.

📝 Feedback and Issues

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please join our Discord and let us know!
